description: This file serves as a module index in a TypeScript project, exporting various type definitions, classes, and functions from multiple related modules within the plugin SDK of an open-source project. It primarily consolidates exports for types, classes, and functions used elsewhere in the project, acting as an aggregator for the plugin-related interfaces and types.

methods.name: registerContextEngine
methods.description: Registers a context engine in the system, as provided in the imported module.

methods.name: delegateCompactionToRuntime
methods.description: Delegates configuration or data compaction tasks to the runtime, as exported from the registry module.

methods.name: onDiagnosticEvent
methods.description: Sets up an event handler or listener for diagnostic events within the infrastructure.
